audience: print-on-demand sellers and operations teams who use Prodigi

useCases.title: Track print orders and shipments
useCases.text: Read a page of orders, then inspect an order by ID for production status, shipment details and available tracking.

useCases.title: Compare shipping quotes before ordering
useCases.text: Request prices for specified SKUs, copies and destination country, then compare the returned shipping options without creating or paying for an order.

useCases.title: Check product requirements for a quote
useCases.text: Inspect a product SKU for supported attributes, required print areas and destination variants before building a quote request.

useCases.title: Inspect available order actions
useCases.text: Check which actions Prodigi currently permits on an order. This connector reports their availability without changing or cancelling the order.

useCases.title: Calculate a photobook spine width
useCases.text: Calculate the spine width for a book SKU, destination and page count when preparing cover artwork.
